basic_info.description: Absolutely bargain deal!! Don't miss out on an incredible opportunity to own a charming home or for extra income in the vibrant Bayview district. Conveniently located near public transportation, dining and shopping.  This spacious home has a lot of potential, whether you're a first time home buyer or investor looking for a value in a rising neighborhood. Rare find at an unbeatable price.
